posts.title: Glo AI Chatbot & Motion-Interactive Wall
posts.summary: Led the delivery of an AI-driven, motion-interactive installation combining conversational AI with Kinect-powered visuals for live brand activations.
posts.description: Architected and delivered an immersive installation for Glo that fused real-time conversational AI with Kinect-based motion tracking. Users interacted verbally with an on-screen assistant while their physical gestures dynamically controlled large-scale visual effects. The system was designed for high-footfall environments, prioritising responsiveness, stability, and intuitive interaction. It successfully blended AI, physical movement, and storytelling to create a memorable brand experience.

posts.title: Web3D Solar CAD & Simulation Engine
posts.summary: Engineered a Web3D CAD engine for solar rooftop design, optimising panel placement and simulation accuracy using environmental data.
posts.description: Led the development of a Web3D CAD engine purpose-built for rooftop solar installations. The platform integrated roof geometry analysis, shading calculations, and automated panel placement to accelerate system design. Real-time simulations and energy estimations improved both accuracy and decision-making. The solution significantly reduced design time while improving installation efficiency.

posts.title: SwiftXR – No-Code AR/VR Creation Platform
posts.summary: Pioneered the development of a no-code platform enabling businesses to create and deploy 3D, AR, and VR experiences at scale.
posts.description: Designed and built SwiftXR, a no-code platform that simplifies the creation, publishing, and deployment of immersive experiences. The system abstracts complex XR workflows into reusable components, enabling non-technical users to build interactive content. Industry-specific solutions supported e-commerce, interior design, and product visualisation use cases. The platform achieved rapid adoption across multiple sectors.

posts.title: Web3D & VR Metaverse Platform
posts.summary: Contributed to the development of a multiplayer VR and Web3D metaverse platform integrating blockchain-based virtual land ownership.
posts.description: Collaborated on the development of a metaverse platform combining immersive VR environments with Web3D interfaces and blockchain infrastructure. The project included a multiplayer VR experience and a real-time 3D map for virtual land transactions. Users could visualise, buy, and manage NFT-based properties within a persistent world. The platform prioritised scalability and real-time interaction.

posts.title: VR Training Platform for Health, Safety & Environment
posts.summary: Delivered an immersive VR training system to improve safety awareness and decision-making in high-risk work environments.
posts.description: Developed a VR training platform simulating real-world health and safety scenarios in a controlled, risk-free environment. Users engaged with interactive hazards, emergency simulations, and procedural training modules. The experience replaced static training materials with immersive learning, improving engagement and knowledge retention. The system was designed for industrial safety training at scale.

posts.title: L’Oréal Web3D & AR Hair Styling Experience
posts.summary: Engineered an interactive Web3D and AR platform enabling users to experiment with real-time digital hair styling.
posts.description: Collaborated on the development of an interactive Web3D and AR experience for L’Oréal that allowed users to explore and customise hairstyles in real time. The platform combined realistic visual rendering with responsive interaction to support creative experimentation. Advanced 3D assets and optimisation techniques ensured performance across devices. The experience blended beauty, creativity, and immersive technology.

posts.title: Lloyds Banking Interactive Campus Experience
posts.summary: Delivered a modular AI-powered engagement platform for Lloyds Banking Group, reaching over 11,000 students across campuses.
posts.description: Engineered a mobile, modular engagement platform combining conversational AI with interactive digital displays. Deployed within a travelling campus installation, the system delivered personalised financial education experiences. Its scalable architecture enabled rapid configuration across multiple locations. The activation achieved high engagement across thousands of student interactions.

posts.title: Wondaland 360° Virtual Reality Album Experience
posts.summary: Designed and delivered a 360° VR experience translating a physical music tour into an immersive digital environment.
posts.description: Created a fully immersive 360-degree VR experience for the Wondaland album, reimagining the physical tour as a virtual journey. Fans explored themed environments inspired by the music, enhanced with spatial audio and interactive storytelling. The experience expanded audience reach beyond physical venues and introduced a new way to engage with music releases.

posts.title: Mastercard Spend & Win Activation Platform
posts.summary: Built an interactive mobile platform supporting purchase-based raffles for a large-scale Mastercard activation campaign.
posts.description: Designed and developed a mobile application that integrated with payment workflows to enable automated raffle entry based on user spending. The system included real-time notifications, engagement mechanics, and campaign analytics. The experience increased participation and enhanced brand interaction during live activations.

posts.title: Marriott Hotel WebAR Room Exploration
posts.summary: Delivered a browser-based AR experience allowing users to explore hotel rooms and amenities interactively.
posts.description: Built a WebAR experience enabling prospective guests to visualise hotel rooms, layouts, and amenities directly in the browser. Interactive 3D models enhanced engagement during the booking journey. The solution improved digital presence and supported more informed booking decisions through immersive exploration.

posts.title: Experimental VR Input System: Hand, Eye & Haptics
posts.summary: Prototyped a multi-modal VR interaction system combining hand tracking, eye gaze, and haptic feedback.
posts.description: Developed an experimental VR prototype exploring advanced interaction techniques using hand gestures, eye tracking, and haptic feedback. Introduced a custom gaze-based selection system focused on comfort and reduced fatigue. The modular design supported rapid iteration and usability testing for immersive interfaces.

posts.title: Maritime Ship Steering Simulation
posts.summary: Engineered a high-fidelity ship steering simulator for maritime training and safety education.
posts.description: Built a real-time maritime simulation featuring realistic ocean physics, wind conditions, and docking scenarios. Designed for professional training environments, the system improved operator preparedness and reduced onboarding time. The simulation delivered hands-on experience within a controlled and repeatable environment.

posts.title: HOFT Machine Web3D & AR Training Platform
posts.summary: Developed a browser-based Web3D and AR platform for interactive industrial machine training.
posts.description: Created a Web3D and AR training platform enabling students to explore and simulate industrial machine operations. Interactive 3D models and guided workflows supported hands-on learning without physical equipment. The platform was integrated into engineering education programs and used to deliver portfolio-ready XR training experiences.

posts.title: AI-Powered AR Smart Glasses for Hearing Accessibility
posts.summary: Engineered an AI-driven smart glasses system providing real-time subtitles to improve communication accessibility.
posts.description: Developed a smart glasses application delivering real-time speech-to-text subtitles directly within the user’s field of view. The system supported adjustable display settings and multilingual voice recognition. Designed for accessibility and low-latency performance, the solution improved communication in educational, public, and professional settings.
